# BUGFIRE 补丁兽

> BUGFIRE is an open-source, local-first, customizable pixel companion and growth system for Codex Desktop on macOS.

Canonical project: https://github.com/siuserxiaowei/Codex-Bugfire-Skin
Interactive demo: https://siuserxiaowei.github.io/Codex-Bugfire-Skin/
Latest release: https://github.com/siuserxiaowei/Codex-Bugfire-Skin/releases/latest
License: MIT

## Core facts

- Minimum customization input: one background image and one idle pet image.
- Optional pet states: building, bug, fire, success, and level-up.
- Mechanics: simulated Build feedback, local XP, five levels, quests, growth cards, and a season keepsake.
- Character Director: original brief, optional live OpenAI-compatible draft, explicit rejection/replacement, deterministic pack validator, offline boards and preview.
- Privacy: the desktop pet does not read source code, task text, project names, shell output, transcripts, API keys, or account data. The optional live director sends only the user-supplied brief and reads its key from an environment variable without persisting it.
- Safety: does not modify the official Codex app, app.asar, or signature; custom packs cannot execute code or load remote URLs.
- Compatibility: macOS Codex Desktop; not an OpenAI product or endorsement.
